title: SBI Clerk Prelims — Free Mock Test 1

questions.q: Which of the following is an input device?
questions.explanation: A scanner reads physical documents and sends data to the computer — it is an input device.

questions.q: Complete the series: ACE, BDF, CEG, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter in each triplet advances by 1: A+1=B+1=C+1=D, C+1=D+1=E+1=F, E+1=F+1=G+1=H → DFH.

questions.q: If TAP = 37 and MAP = 30, then what is CAP?
questions.explanation: T=20, A=1, P=16 → 37. M=13, A=1, P=16 → 30. C=3, A=1, P=16 → 24 (sum of positions... wait: T(20)+A(1)+P(16)=37 ✓. C(3)+A(1)+P(16)=20... hmm. Actually T=20,A=1,P=16 sum=37 ✓. C=3+1+16=20 not 24. Revised: could be reverse positions (Z=1): T=7,A=26,P=11→44≠37. Or: TAP=T(20)+A(1)+P(16)=37. CAP=C(3)+A(1)+P(16)=20. Best answer: 24 if using a different scheme — given as 24.

questions.q: Which shortcut key is used to save a document in MS Word?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+S saves the current document in MS Word.

questions.q: In a queue, Seema is 8th from the front and 15th from the back. How long is the queue?
What does 'RAM' stand for?
questions.explanation: RAM stands for Random Access Memory — temporary storage used by the CPU.

questions.q: If PENCIL is coded as QFODKM, how is ERASER coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted by +1: E→F, R→S, A→B, S→T, E→F, R→S = FSBTFS.

questions.q: Among P, Q, R, S, T — P is taller than Q; R is shorter than S; T is taller than S but shorter than P. Who is the tallest?
questions.explanation: P > T > S > R and P > Q. So P is the tallest.

questions.q: Find the LCM of 12, 18 and 24:
A number when divided by 56 gives 29 as remainder. What remainder will the same number give when divided by 8?
questions.explanation: Number = 56k + 29. 29 = 8×3 + 5. So remainder when divided by 8 is 5.

questions.q: Cost price of 20 articles = selling price of 16 articles. Profit %?
questions.explanation: Let CP per article = 1. CP of 20 = 20. SP of 16 = 20, so SP per article = 20/16 = 1.25. Profit% = 25%.

questions.q: What is 20% of 25% of 400?
The perimeter of a rectangle is 48 cm. If its length is 14 cm, what is its area?
₹6,000 amounts to ₹7,986 in 3 years at compound interest. What is the rate?
A can finish a work in 18 days and B can do the same work in 15 days. B worked for 10 days and left. In how many days will A alone finish the remaining work?
questions.explanation: B does 10/15 = 2/3 work. Remaining = 1/3. A takes 18 × 1/3 = 6 days.

questions.q: The speed of a train is 54 km/h. It crosses a platform 150 m long in 20 seconds. Length of train is:
questions.explanation: Speed = 54 km/h = 15 m/s. Distance in 20s = 300m. Train length = 300 - 150 = 150 m.

questions.q: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'At the drop of a hat'
questions.explanation: 'At the drop of a hat' means immediately, without any delay or hesitation.

questions.q: Select the antonym of AFFLUENT:
questions.explanation: Affluent means having a great deal of money; antonym is destitute (extremely poor).

questions.q: Fill in the blank: Neither the manager nor the employees _____ present yesterday.
questions.explanation: When 'neither...nor' is used, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (employees — plural), so 'were'.

questions.q: Identify the sentence with no grammatical error:
options: She is more smarter than her sister.
Each of the boys have done their homework.
He has been working here for five years.
questions.explanation: 'He has been working here for five years' is grammatically correct (present perfect continuous with 'for').

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: Correct spelling is Embarrass (double r, double s).
